title: Offer
key_points: An Offer is a pre-authorized payment of XRP from an account to another account.
The Amount field specifies the amount of XRP to be paid.
The Interval field specifies how often the payment will occur, in seconds.
If there are enough funds and the account has sufficient permissions, the Offer will be added to the ledger.
Offers can be created by any account with an Authorize() or RegularKey(), but only the owner of the offer's Destination account can cancel it.
limitations: The source assumes prior knowledge of XRP Ledger concepts and terminology.
It provides a technical description without broader context or applications.
The scope of the information is limited to Offers within the XRP Ledger system.
asserts: An Offer in the XRP Ledger allows an account to create a pre-authorized payment of XRP from their account to another specified account.
scope: The scope of this assertion is the XRP Ledger, specifically how Offers function and are utilized within its payment system.
